latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator for YouTube.

- Upload YouTube video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) directly to generate captions.
- Request captions in multiple languages (e.g., English, Spanish) with a simple prompt.
- Download 1080p MP4 videos with embedded, AI-generated captions in about 30–90 seconds.
- Simple workflow: upload, describe what you want, and get a ready-to-post video—no manual editing needed.
- Supports checking credits, session status, and exporting processed videos.
- Robust error handling and clear user feedback for common issues (token, file size/type, rate limits).
